title: Bissell Park multi-use pad project restarted
subtitle: Committee also reviewed a new Code of Conduct and Integrity Commissioner role for Council and local boards.
overview: The Committee of the Whole took up the stalled Bissell Park multi-use pad project in Elora. It recommended ending the existing grant agreement with the Elora Lions Club and the construction company, and having the Township take the lead on finishing the project {{vote:m2}}.

The recommendation includes allocating $413,255.52 in existing funds, issuing a request for proposal for a design consultant with an upset limit of $100,000, and creating a working group under the Healthy Communities Advisory Committee. The working group would include representatives of the Elora Rockers and the Elora Lions Club. A delegate asked for an open, welcoming rink without boards that keeps existing uses of the space.

The committee also heard from the Township's Integrity Commissioner about a draft Code of Conduct and Complaint Protocol for Council members and local board members. It recommended that Council adopt it {{vote:m3}}.
Because this was a committee meeting, both items go to Council for final adoption.

decisions.item: Ending the Bissell Park pad grant agreement
decisions.detail: The committee recommended that Council terminate the 2020 Jack R MacDonald Grant Agreement for the Bissell Park Multi-Use Pad Project.
The committee recommended that Council allocate $413,255.52 in existing funds to the project, as outlined in report CS2023-21.
The committee recommended that staff issue a request for proposal for design, construction-ready documents and a Class A budget, to an upset limit of $100,000.
The committee recommended a Bissell Park Multi-Use Pad Project Working Group under the Healthy Communities Advisory Committee, including Elora Rockers and Elora Lions Club representatives.

decisions.item: Code of Conduct and Complaint Protocol
decisions.detail: The committee recommended that Council adopt the Code of Conduct and Complaint Protocol for Council Members and Members of Local Boards, as presented by the Integrity Commissioner.
